assumptions.pairing: exact full-stimulus SHA256 and byte equality; independent repeat means of measured currents

input.voltage: existing latimer2019.voltage_zoh; native V0=EL at source t=0; full 1s prefix propagated
input.history: observed strict past; zero only before recording; all scored history inside actual 1s prefix

split.rule: lexicographically sorted full stimulus SHA256; first4 train, next2 validation, last2 sealed_test
split.reason: All8 complete existing-loader cross-mode groups; two of10 lack I. Transparent 4/2/2 conditional replacement for full10 6/2/2, fixed before any loss.
split.test_policy: offline labels permitted for domain checks only; test metrics once after candidate freeze; never tune from test

parameters.bound_rationale: Declared engineering search domain, not physiological prior. alpha positive, two log10 decades either side of native Hz scale. mu covers fixed reversal plus full history envelope with4 fixed beta margins; no data or loss used. Bounds freeze before optimize.

optimizer.objective: unregularized native teacher-forced Bernoulli NLL per training bin
optimizer.validation_policy: one final validation after training convergence; no validation-guided retries
optimizer.candidate_acceptance: converged, actual nonzero parameter update, validation NLL <= unchanged native and < training-estimated constant-rate baseline
optimizer.domain_error_policy: stop candidate immediately; no clipping or implicit retry
optimizer.resume: restart L-BFGS-B at saved accepted iterate with remaining global iteration/evaluation budgets; curvature not preserved

psth_labels: free_history exact8-state marginal initialized at native zero history and propagated through full1s prefix
evaluation.sensitivity: only origin0 fixed-policy train/validation once after freezing main candidate; no optimization, no origin selection, no sealed-test sensitivity

resources.stage_timing: first real train evaluation records voltage prep, cold objective, warm objective; cost projection from measured maxfun and callbacks; no legacy global wall budget
